data.author: 7d7n
data.article_summary:
本文讨论了在LLM（大型语言模型）时代，推荐系统和搜索引擎的演变。传统推荐系统依赖ID进行项目嵌入，但面临冷启动和新项目推荐的挑战。文章介绍了一种基于Semantic ID的方法，通过Transformer生成内容嵌入，并使用RQ-VAE将其压缩为离散ID，以提高效率。结果显示，这种方法在冷启动场景中优于随机哈希方法。

此外，文章还提到M3CSR框架，利用多模态内容（视觉、文本、音频）嵌入，通过K-means聚类生成可训练的类别ID，并采用双塔架构优化在线推理效率。这些方法通过结合内容理解和行为建模，提升了推荐系统的性能，特别是在处理新项目和不常见项目推荐时表现更为出色。

Improving Recommendation Systems & Search in the Age of LLMs
[

· 43 min read
Recommendation systems and search have historically drawn inspiration from language modeling. For example, the adoption of
Word2vec
to learn item embeddings (for embedding-based retrieval), and using
GRUs
,
Transformer
, and
BERT
to predict the next best item (for ranking). The current paradigm of large language models is no different.
Here, we’ll discuss how industrial search and recommendation systems have evolved over the past year or so and cover model architectures, data generation, training paradigms, and unified frameworks:
LLM/multimodality-augmented model architecture
LLM-assisted data generation and analysis
Scaling Laws, transfer learning, distillation, LoRAs, etc.
Unified architectures for search and recommendations
LLM/multimodality-augmented model architecture
Recommendation models are increasingly adopting language models and multimodal content to overcome traditional limitations of ID-based approaches. These hybrid architectures include content understanding alongside the strengths of behavioral modeling, addressing the common challenges of cold-start and long-tail item recommendations.
Semantic IDs (YouTube)
explores content-derived features as substitutes for traditional hash-based IDs.
This approach targets difficulties in predicting user preferences for new and infrequently interacted items. Their solution involves a two-stage framework.
In the first stage, a transformer-based video encoder (similar to Video-BERT) generates dense content embeddings. These embeddings are then compressed into discrete Semantic IDs through a Residual Quantization Variational AutoEncoder (RQ-VAE). Representing user histories with these compact semantic IDs—a few integers rather than high-dimensional embeddings—significantly improves efficiency. Once trained, the RQ-VAE is frozen and used to generate Semantic IDs for the second stage to train a production-scale ranking model.
The RQ-VAE itself is a single-layer encoder-decoder structure with a 256-dimensional latent space. It has eight quantization levels with a codebook of 2048 entries per level. The encoder maps content embeddings to a latent vector, while a residual quantizer discretizes this vector, and the decoder reconstructs the original embedding. The initial embeddings originate from a transformer with a VideoBERT backbone, producing detailed, 2048-dimensional representations that capture the topical content in video.
To integrate Semantic IDs into ranking models, the authors propose two techniques: an N-gram-based approach, which groups fixed-length sequences, and a SentencePiece Model (SPM)-based method that adaptively learns variable-length subwords. The ranking model is a multi-task production ranking model that recommends the next video to watch given the current video and user history.
Results:
Directly using the dense content embeddings performed worse than using random hash IDs. The authors hypothesize that ranking models heavily rely on memorization from the ID-based embedding tables—replacing these with
fixed
dense content embeddings led to poorer CTR. However, both N-gram and SPM methods did better than random hashing, especially in cold-start scenarios. Ablation tests revealed that while N-gram approaches had a slight advantage when embedding table sizes were limited (e.g., $8 \times K$ or $4 \times K^2$), SPM methods offered superior generalization and efficiency with larger embedding tables.
Dense content embeddings (dashed lines) perform worse than random hashing (solid orange).
Similarly,
M3CSR (Kuaishou)
introduces multimodal content embeddings (visual, textual, audio) clustered via K-means into trainable category IDs.
This transforms static content embeddings into adaptable, behavior-aligned representations.
The M3CSR framework has a dual-tower architecture, splitting user-side and item-side towers to optimize for online inference efficiency where user and item embeddings can be pre-computed and indexed via approximate nearest neighbor indices. Item embeddings are derived from multimodal pretrained models—ResNet for visual, Sentence-BERT for text, and VGGish for audio—and concatenated into a single embedding vector. These vectors are then clustered using K-means (with approximately 1,000 clusters from over 10 million videos).
Next, cluster IDs are embedded through a Modal Encoder, a dense network translating content features into behaviorally aligned spaces and assigning trainable embeddings. The Modal Encoder uses a dense network to learn the mapping from content-space to behavior space and a cluster ID lookup to assign a trainable cluster ID embedding.

data.title: Metabolism Can Shape Cells' Destinies
data.author: isaacfrond
data.article_summary: 文章主要探讨了细胞代谢在生命早期发育过程中的关键作用。传统观点认为，细胞命运由基因调控网络决定，但新研究表明，细胞代谢同样至关重要。代谢不仅提供能量，还生成代谢物，影响基因活动和细胞分化。例如，葡萄糖代谢能影响胚胎发育的初期阶段。环境和饮食等外部因素通过影响代谢物水平，进而决定细胞命运和胚胎发育。这一发现改变了对发育生物学的理解，并揭示了代谢在细胞存活、死亡甚至癌症中的重要性。研究显示，代谢与基因同样对细胞分化起决定性作用，打破了基因在发育过程中占主导地位的传统观念。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：生物电实验及其影响

不同观点：
• 一些评论者对Michael Levin的生物电实验表示兴趣，特别是他通过生物电操控使扁平虫长出两个头的实验。这种实验展示了生物体在基因相同情况下，通过调节生物电可以产生不同的形态结构，令人印象深刻。例如，[rolisz]提到这个实验让他们想起了Levin的工作，并对这种“奇特”的科学操作感到兴奋。

• 另一部分评论者则关注这种实验的伦理问题和潜在风险。他们提出，虽然这类实验展示了生物体形态的巨大可塑性，但也引发了关于人类干预自然生命过程的伦理争议。例如，有评论者担心这类实验可能带来不可预见的后果，尤其是在应用于更复杂的生物体时。

补充讨论：
• 有评论者讨论了这类实验的未来应用前景，认为生物电技术可能在再生医学和组织工程中发挥重要作用。例如，通过操控生物电，科学家可能能够诱导人体组织再生，治疗创伤或疾病。

• 还有一些评论者对实验的技术细节和原理表现出兴趣，询问生物电如何具体影响细胞行为和发育过程，希望了解更多关于Levin实验背后的科学机制。

• 最后，部分评论者提到了这种实验的哲学意义，探讨了生命本质的可塑性和复杂性，质疑传统的生物学分类和定义是否足够描述这些新的科学发现。

争议焦点：实验的伦理问题和潜在风险，特别是在更复杂生物体上的应用。

To develop into a complex, multicellular being, that cell must divide, and then those cells must divide again, and again — and then these stem cells start to specialize into different types, with different destinies in our bodies. In the first week, our cells reach their first turning point: They must become either placenta or embryo. Then, in the developing embryo, cells form three primary layers — ectoderm, mesoderm and endoderm — which, over time, become skin, neurons, heart, gut, and so on.
These determinations of cells’ fates — what type of specialized cell they will become — occur in stages throughout embryonic development. Because each cell type has a characteristic pattern of gene activity, scientists assumed that the decisions cells make are dictated by genes: specifically,
networks of genes
that turn each other on and off, initiating a cascade that forms the correct types of cells in the correct order.
But genes are not the whole story. New research has shown the extent to which cell metabolism — the chemical reactions within a cell that provide energy and materials for growth — has an important, underappreciated role in directing cell fates.
“Metabolism is more than just housekeeping in stem cells, especially embryonic stem cells,” said
Jan Żylicz
, a developmental biologist at the University of Copenhagen. “It’s a crucial pathway that regulates decision-making processes.”
In the course of their whirring biochemical activity, cells not only produce energy but also synthesize metabolites: molecular biological building blocks, such as amino acids, nucleotides, carbohydrates and lipids. In the last decade or two, with the development of better methods for measuring metabolites in cells, there has been a surge of interest in the various ways these small molecules regulate gene activity, and in particular cell fate and development. Now, studies suggest that their presence or absence — which can be influenced by external factors, such as environment and diet — can determine the fate of a cell and, in turn, the development of an embryo.

The curious case of Hinge and SATC

Three years ago, I swiped right on the man who would become my husband. We met on Hinge. A few months ago, while watching an old episode of Sex and the City with a girlfriend, we hit the crossword scene -
Carrie helping Big with the word ‘Hinge.’
The show aired years before the app was born, so no, this wasn’t product placement.
But when I saw that, I remembered Hinge (the app). By then, I had already deleted Hinge, following its infamous tagline - “Designed to be Deleted.
”
But even after that, the app was a part of my subconscious. It was branding baked into my memory. That moment was weirdly nostalgic.
Emotions dramatically influence memory retention and loyalty.
Neuro-imaging studies
show that emotionally charged marketing campaigns activate the amygdala, the brain’s emotional center. When you emotionally resonate with a brand - you become a loyal customer, an unpaid brand ambassador, so to speak. I may not be a customer anymore but I’m definitely a success story.
How does Hinge stand out if it’s basically just another chat app for singles?
The Economics of Hope
Let’s be honest, most dating apps are barely-functional-dollar-stores disguised as “connection platforms.” The stats are bleak. Industry-wide, only about 10% of users find a long-term partner. Hinge? Roughly
5%
. That’s worse than your odds at a Vegas table (
a good 35%-50%
). But still, people flock to it. Why? Because marketing sells possibility, not probability. It sells the dream of being in the lucky minority
.
Hinge doesn’t succeed because it matches people better, it succeeds because
it markets hope better
. And this hope is addictive. That’s the essence of positioning - it creates meaning where none inherently exists.
And, based on the latest financial data, Hinge is making some serious money. In 2024, it generated an impressive $550 million in revenue, marking a 39% increase from 2023. With 30 million active users and 1.5 million paying subscribers (a 23% year-over-year increase), the app has made hope into a lucrative business model. Each paying user generates an average of $29.94 in revenue, contributing to an adjusted operating income of $166 million, a healthy 30% profit margin.
Based on Hinge’s 2024 actuals, upcoming
global launch
of the revamped algorithm,  and expanded market reach, it is reasonable to project that in 2025, Hinge could reach 1.8–1.9 million payers at an RPP of about $31–32, driving direct revenue up to roughly $680–700 million. All this from an app with a 5% success rate.
Positioning in a Sea of Sameness
Hinge’s tagline is brilliantly simple: "Designed to be Deleted." In this competitive market of apps that want to maximize screen time, Hinge positions itself as the app that wants users to succeed and leave. It’s so original and aligns directly with the user’s goal - finding someone meaningful enough to delete the app for.
Talk about competition, Tinder thrives on hookup culture with gamified swiping mechanics, Bumble empowers women to initiate conversation. But Hinge openly acknowledges the user’s ultimate desire. While Tinder and Bumble operate on pure reptilian impulses of swipe, match, ghost, repeat. Hinge sells itself as a solution to the problem that others created, like an antidote of the dating-app fatigue. Its core functionality (profiles, photos, messaging) is fundamentally similar, but the positioning completely flips the perception. It speaks in calm, nurturing tones, the kind that tricks you into thinking you’re making rational choices. Its interface is clean, minimalist. No neon-colored signs, just soft colors, personality prompts, and the promise that you are a discerning, relationship-minded adult rather than a dopamine-addicted cat in heat.
Hinge effectively signals that it values long-term happiness over short-term engagement, which makes people more willing to believe in the brand​. The company doubles down on this theme across all its messaging, even creating a mascot ‘Hingie’ that celebrates its own deletion with joyful self-destruction. The dark humor just reinforces Hinge’s authenticity. By daring to say “success means we disappear,” Hinge has set itself apart from the pack and strengthened its brand equity.
Marketing Creates Meaning
Hinge isn’t the only one that focuses on creating emotional loyalty.
De Beers’ “A Diamond is Forever
” stands as the longest running marketing campaign of all time, having started in 1947. It’s successfully linked diamonds with eternal love and is responsible for making diamond engagement rings a culture.
Apple’s iconic
silhouette iPod campaigns
never mentioned storage capacity or battery life. They sold the feeling of dancing to your own soundtrack.
Nike

data.article_summary: 本文讲述了高端音频线制造商Monster Cables向Blue Jeans Cable发出停止侵权通知后，遭到其总裁Kurt Denke强硬反击的故事。Denke是 former litigator，他要求Monster Cables提供详细证据，否则将视其放弃指控。他表明自己绝不妥协，即使花费巨资也要捍卫原则，且拒绝在无侵权情况下签署任何许可协议。Denke的坚定立场显示出他对无理诉讼的强烈抵制，并暗示Monster Cables惯用威胁手段获取和解与许可费用。本文提醒企业在处理法律纠纷时应注重证据交换，而非轻易威胁诉讼。

Monster Cables picked the wrong guy to threaten
by
Dell C. "D. C." Toedt III
on
2008-04-16
Monster Cables, which makes extremely high-priced stereo cables, has apparently sent a
cease-and-desist letter
to
Blue Jeans Cable
, alleging various kinds of infringement.  Bad move – the president of Blue Jeans Cable, Kurt Denke, is a former litigator who
responded pretty forcefully
:
… Once I have received the above materials and explanations from you, I will undertake to analyze this information and let you know whether we are willing to accede to any of the demands made in your letter.
If my analysis shows that there is any reasonable likelihood that we have infringed in any way any of Monster Cable’s intellectual property rights, we will of course take any and all action necessary to resolve the situation.
If I do not hear from you within the next fourteen days, or if I do hear from you but do not receive
all of the information requested above, I will assume that you have abandoned these claims and closed your file.
As for your requests for information, or for action, directed to me: I would remind you that it is you, not I, who are making claims; and it is you, not I, who must substantiate those claims.  You have not done so.
I have seen Monster Cable take untenable IP positions in various different scenarios in the past, and am generally familiar with what seems to be Monster Cable’s
modus operandi in these matters.  I therefore think that it is important that, before closing, I make you aware of a few points.
After graduating from the University of Pennsylvania Law School in 1985, I spent nineteen years in litigation practice, with a focus upon federal litigation involving large damages and complex issues.  My first seven years were spent primarily on the defense side, where
I developed an intense frustration with insurance carriers who would settle meritless claims for nuisance value when the better long-term view would have been to fight against vexatious litigation as a matter of principle.
In plaintiffs’ practice, likewise, I was always a strong advocate of standing upon principle and taking cases all the way to judgment, even when substantial offers of settlement were on the table.  I am “uncompromising” in the most literal sense of the word.  If Monster Cable proceeds with litigation against me I will pursue the same merits-driven approach; I do not compromise with bullies and
I would rather spend fifty thousand dollars on defense than give you a dollar of unmerited settlement funds.
As for signing a licensing agreement for intellectual property which I have not infringed: that will not happen, under any circumstances, whether it makes economic sense or not.
I say this because my observation has been that Monster Cable typically operates in a hit-and-run fashion.  Your client threatens litigation, expecting the victim to panic and plead for mercy; and what follows is a quickie negotiation session that ends with payment and a licensing agreement.  Your client then uses this collection of licensing agreements to convince others under similar threat to accede to its demands.  Let me be clear about this:
there are only two ways for you to get anything out of me.  You will either need to (1) convince me that I have infringed, or (2) obtain a final judgment to that effect from a court of competent jurisdiction.
It may be that my inability to see the pragmatic value of settling frivolous claims is a deep character flaw, and I am sure a few of the insurance carriers for whom I have done work have seen it that way; but it is how I have done business for the last quarter-century and you are not going to change my mind.  If you sue me, the case will go to judgment, and I will hold the court’s attention upon the merits of your claims–or, to speak more precisely, the absence of merit from your claims–from start to finish.
Not only am I unintimidated by litigation; I sometimes rather miss it.
(Emphasis added; hat tip: Jeff Nolan at
Venture Chronicles
.)
I can relate to Denke’s final comment quoted above ….  I wonder what the attendant publicity is doing for his sales.

data.title: Mindfulness mediates the association between chronotype and depressive symptoms
data.author: wjb3
data.article_summary: 这篇文章探讨了作息类型（chronotype）与年轻人抑郁症状之间的关系，特别关注了正念、睡眠质量、反刍思维和酒精消费在这些关系中的中介作用。研究对546名大学生进行了横断面调查，结果显示，晚睡型（evening-types）个体的抑郁症状更为严重，睡眠质量较差，正念中的“行动意识”和“描述”能力较低，反刍思维和酒精消费较高。中介分析表明，作息类型与抑郁症状的关联可以通过“行动意识”、“描述”、睡眠质量以及酒精消费来解释。由于研究仅使用了主观测量且为横断面设计，无法确定因果关系。研究结果强调了针对这些因素进行干预以降低年轻人抑郁风险的潜在重要性。

Abstract
Background
Chronotype influences risk of depression, with evening-types at higher risk, although the reasons for this are uncertain. Potential mediating factors include mindfulness, sleep quality, rumination, and alcohol consumption, but research is lacking.
Methods
We explored the role of these factors in the association between chronotype and depressive symptoms amongst young adults, using cross-sectional data collected from a university student sample (
N
=  546).
Results
Evening-types had significantly higher levels of depression symptoms, poorer sleep quality, and lower levels of ‘acting with awareness’ and ‘describing’, as well as higher rumination and alcohol consumption. Mediation analyses demonstrated that the link between chronotype and depression was fully mediated by ‘acting with awareness’, ‘describing’, sleep quality, and alcohol consumption.
Limitations
Only subjective measures were employed, and due to the cross-sectional design, no causal inferences can be made.
Conclusion
The mediation results shed light on the crucial role of specific mindfulness facets, sleep, and alcohol consumption for explaining why evening types are at higher risk of depression; findings have import for potential interventions aiming to reduce depression risk amongst young adults in particular.

Morningness-eveningness (or diurnal preference) refers to an individual’s sleep-wake behaviour (preferred bed and wake times, and times preferred for peak cognitive/physical performance). Diurnal preference impacts mental health: studies have linked a tendency towards eveningness (late chronotype) to a higher risk of major depressive disorder (MDD) [
1
,
2
]. Eveningness is significantly associated with MDD even when potential confounders, e.g., sociodemographic factors, somatic health, sleep duration and insomnia ratings, are controlled for [
1
,
3
,
4
]. Meta-analyses have shown that evening types have higher levels of depressive symptomatology in both non-clinical and clinical populations [
5
,
6
]. In these, no difference in effect size was observed between clinical and nonclinical samples, suggesting that eveningness may raise vulnerability for depression rather than being a consequence of it. Indeed, studies have associated eveningness with neuroticism (a personality trait describing individuals who are more emotionally reactive and prone to experience negative emotions and depression), negative biases in emotional processing and impaired emotion regulation [
7
,
8
]. However, knowledge around the mechanisms linking eveningness to depression is lacking. This is of particular import given the high incidence of depression, particularly in young adult populations, with over 60% of mental health problems established by age 25 [
9
].
Despite being considered to be a relatively stable trait in adulthood (and with a high heritability and genetic component [
10
]), an individuals’ diurnal preference do tend to vary across the lifespan [
11
,
12
]; lateness tendency peaks in late adolescence/early adulthood and thus a large proportion of individuals aged 17 to 25 are typically categorised as evening-types [
12
,
13
]. Lateness tendency then tends to plateau before a gradual trend towards morningness becomes evident in later life [
13
]. Young adulthood, when eveningness peaks, corresponds with a higher risk of MDD symptoms compared to other age groups [
14

15
–
17

18

19

data.title: ChatGPT can't kill anything worth preserving
data.author: sandebert
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：针对ChatGPT及大型语言模型（LLMs）的评价与争议

不同观点：
• simonw认为，这篇2022年的文档在2025年时将更多具有历史意义，而不是对当前LLM技术的有用批评。他认为，ChatGPT自2022年推出以来（基于GPT-3.5），技术已经有了快速发展，因此该文档的评价部分可能已经过时。
• knowknow持反对意见，认为那些将LLM技术视作 trivial（琐碎）和 stagnant（停滞）的人是在回避技术进步的事实。他强调LLM已经迅速改进，写作能力超过大多数人，并指出将LLM视作仅仅是“模式匹配”的观点是为了减轻对被取代的恐惧。同时，knowknow认为人类推理本质上也是基于对过去经验的模式识别。
• zedascouves通过实际实验反驳了某个评论中的说法，即ChatGPT无法识别“1970年代使用Instagram”的异常。他展示了ChatGPT通过创造性的方式解释了这一时间错位，认为这种表现很棒。

补充讨论：
• bryanrasmussen提出一个新问题，即这种技术是否可能带来损害，但没有展开具体讨论。
• gostsamo的评论较为简短，可能只是强调2022年的时间点，没有详细阐述观点。
• drpossum指出“Worth”一词在讨论中承担了较多解释责任，暗示对价值的讨论可能需要更深入的分析。

争议焦点：
• ChatGPT和LLM技术的现状及未来发展：simonw认为过去的评价不再适用，knowknow则认为技术进步显著且不容小觑。
• LLM是否仅仅是“模式匹配”：knowknow认为将LLM视作模式匹配的观点低估了其能力，并与人类推理方式相比较。

data.title: Feral pig meat transmits rare bacteria
data.author: abawany
data.article_summary: 2020年秋，佛罗里达州一名77岁男子持续胸痛就医，最终发现他感染了极为罕见的**布鲁氏菌病**，由**Brucella suis**引起。该细菌通常存在于猪体内，人类感染多与处理和食用野猪生肉有关。该男子是一名牧师，住在有狗和山羊的农场，他回忆起2017年曾多次收到猎人赠送的野猪肉，并徒手处理了生肉。虽然他有多种基础疾病，包括2型糖尿病和高血压，但真正导致他长期不适的原因是植入心脏设备上的隐匿感染。经过多次抗生素治疗无效后，医生移除了该设备，并检测出**B. suis**感染。该细菌曾被列为潜在生物恐怖威胁，但2020年初被移出该名单。男子可能通过处理野猪肉感染，而其农场动物传播的可能性较低。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕感染病诊断过程、特定疾病（布鲁氏菌病）、猪肉禁忌以及医疗费用的讨论

不同观点：
• **larusso**：分享了自己类似经历，描述了长期寻找病因的困难。尽管进行了多次血液测试，最终通过胃镜和结肠镜检查才发现是由于细菌或真菌感染。他怀疑感染源可能来自2018年在埃及食用的食物。这一观点强调了诊断过程的复杂性和可能的外部感染源。

• **kragen**：批评文章标题具有点击诱饵性质，认为应该直接提到“布鲁氏菌病”这个病名，而不是让人以为讨论的是更罕见的疾病。这表明他对文章的标题持批评态度，认为标题不够准确。

• **kazinator**：对文章中患者未能指认具体感染源表示怀疑，认为患者其实知道感染源但不愿透露，可能是因为涉及朋友。此观点暗示了对患者描述的不信任。

• **a3w**：质疑文章中插入“僵尸爆发游戏制作视频”是否是有意为之，还是由自动内容管理系统（CMS）错误插入。这关注的是文章编辑和呈现方式的问题。

• **jdthedisciple**：将文章与最近讨论的“猪肉禁忌”联系起来，认为这有助于理解猪肉可能携带的各种细菌，并暗示猪肉禁忌有一定的智慧。此观点试图将事件与更广泛的文化讨论联系起来。

• **throwanem**：以幽默方式提到文章中的病人，暗示对老年猎人仍参与狩猎活动感到意外。此评论更多是调侃，没有深入讨论疾病本身。

• **taosx**：分享了自己在希腊食用野猪肉的经历，并表示由于文章中的信息，可能会在未来避免食用。此观点表达了对食品安全的个人选择。

• **rvba**：指出文章在描述布鲁氏菌病感染性时的矛盾，认为文章提到该病“极其传染”但同时提供的病例数据较少。这反映了对文章内容准确性的质疑。

• **blackeyeblitzar**：提到当前“猪肉禁忌的起源”讨论，暗示两篇文章可能存在关联性。这属于对更广泛讨论话题的提示。

In the fall of 2020, a 77-year-old man in Florida realized he had gotten one of the worst gifts imaginable—one that kept on giving.
According to
a case report
published in this month's issue of Emerging Infectious Diseases, the man showed up at a Gainesville hospital with chest pain that just wouldn't go away. For nearly two years prior, the man—a pastor living on a rural farm with dogs and goats—had been in and out of hospitals and on and off of various antibiotics.
Generally, the man wasn't in the best health. His medical history included Type 2 diabetes, high blood pressure, high cholesterol, and heart failure with reduced ejection fraction. For the latter, he had an automated implantable cardiac defibrillator (AICD) placed—and it was not his first. The man had a notable history of having gone through multiple defibrillators and revisions, including getting a new generator in 2018. Some possible reasons for such a history could include heavy use of the device and infections.
Throughout his hospital visits in 2019 and 2020, doctors suspected he had an infection lurking in his heart implant. But the germ behind it remained elusive. When they tried to isolate whatever bacteria, fungi, or other pathogen was causing the problem, they couldn't find anything. He was subsequently treated for a "culture-negative" infection. At one point, a test suggested a rare, opportunistic bacterium. But, after treatments with over half a dozen antibiotics for mostly two- to four-week spans over the two years, the discomfort in the left side of his chest would always return.
Hog-wild infection
During the fall 2020 visit, doctors finally rooted out the source of the problem. Blood culture tests showed clumps of some kind of bacteria among his blood cells. Imaging, meanwhile, showed signs of infection around his implant. The doctors were concerned enough that they decided it was time to take the implant out. After removing it, they sent the device and samples to the Florida health department and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, which did clinical and genetic testing. They all turned up
Brucella suis
.
B. suis
is an extremely infectious bacteria that's usually found in pigs. The most common symptom in pigs is reproductive losses, such as stillbirths, though they can also develop other symptoms, such as abscesses and arthritis. In humans, it causes an insidious, hard-to-detect infection called
brucellosis
, which describes an infection from any
Brucella
species:
B. suis, B. melitensis,
B. abortus
, and
B. canis.
In the US, there are only about
80 to 140 brucellosis cases
reported each year, and they're mostly caused by
B. melitensis and B. abortus
. People tend to get infected by eating raw (unpasteurized) milk and cheeses.
B. suis
, however, is generally linked to hunting and butchering feral pigs and hogs.
Until recently, the
Brucella
species were designated as select agents by the US government, a classification to flag pathogens and toxins that can potentially be a severe threat to public health, such as if they're used in a bioterror attack.
The current list
includes things like anthrax and Ebola virus.
Brucella
species were originally listed because they can be easily aerosolized, and only a small number of the bacterial cells are needed to spark an infection. In humans, infections can be both localized and systemic and have
a broad range of clinical manifestations
. Those include brain infections, neurological conditions, arthritis, anemia, respiratory involvement, pancreatitis, cardiovascular complications, like aneurysms, and inflammation of the spinal cord,
among many other things
.
In January
, federal officials removed
Brucella
species from the select agents list—a designation that limits the types and amount of research that can be done on a pathogen. According to the US Department of Agriculture, the reason for the removal was
to ease those limits
, thereby making it easier for researchers to conduct veterinary studies and develop vaccines for animals.
Perilous present
After finding
B. suis
, the doctors gathered more information about how the man could have contracted this rare species. The man said he wasn't a hunter but recalled receiving a gift of feral swine meat from a local hunter on several occasions in 2017. Though he couldn’t recall the specific hunter who gave him the biohazardous bounty, he remembered handling the raw meat and blood with his bare hands—a clear transmission risk—before cooking and eating it.
"This encounter likely served as his exposure to
B. suis
," his doctors concluded. They noted that it is possible the dog and goats on the farm where the man lived also could have picked up the infection from pigs and passed it on to him. But, the doctors deemed this less likely given that there was no evidence of sick animals on the farm, and the m

data.title: A single-fibre computer enables textile networks and distributed inference
data.author: walterbell
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了一种纺织纤维计算机，它集成了模拟传感、数字存储、处理和通信功能，总重量不到5克。通过可折叠的中间层，将微型设备的二维垫架构映射到符合纤维几何形状的三维圆柱布局中。利用螺旋铜微线连接，八种微型设备被热拉成可机洗、可拉伸超过60%的弹性纤维。这种可编程纤维包含一个32位浮点微控制器，能够独立执行边缘计算任务，即使被编织、针织或缝入衣物中。该纤维计算机可以通过光学链接和射频通信实现无线通信，并在实际应用中展示了通过四个纤维计算机联网可将身体活动分类的准确率从67%提高到95%。
data.comments_summary:

不同观点：

• idiotsecant对该硬件表示极大的兴趣，并询问是否有相关图片以进一步了解该技术。

补充讨论：
• vessenes的观点中提到了两个重要问题：一是嵌入式设备技术的进步，使得日常物品（如毛衣）变得智能化；二是这些设备在安全性和使用自由度上的潜在问题，特别是易受黑客攻击和依赖厂商的云服务。

• vessenes的评论还反映了对技术进步和其实际应用之间差距的关注，特别是从科幻设想到现实技术落地的过程中遇到的挑战。

43410666.article_content:
Subjects
Electrical and electronic engineering
Electronic devices
Abstract
Despite advancements in wearable technologies
1
,
2
, barriers remain in achieving distributed computation located persistently on the human body. Here a textile fibre computer that monolithically combines analogue sensing, digital memory, processing and communication in a mass of less than 5 g is presented. Enabled by a foldable interposer, the two-dimensional pad architectures of microdevices were mapped to three-dimensional cylindrical layouts conforming to fibre geometry. Through connection with helical copper microwires, eight microdevices were thermally drawn into a machine-washable elastic fibre capable of more than 60% stretch. This programmable fibre, which incorporates a 32-bit floating-point microcontroller, independently performs edge computing tasks even when braided, woven, knitted or seam-sewn into garments. The universality of the assembly process allows for the integration of additional functions with simple modifications, including a rechargeable fibre power source that operates the computer for nearly 6 h. Finally, we surmount the perennial limitation of rigid interconnects by implementing two wireless communication schemes involving woven optical links and seam-inserted radio-frequency communications. To demonstrate its utility, we show that garments equipped with four fibre computers, one per limb, operating individually trained neural networks achieve, on average, 67% accuracy in classifying physical activity. However, when networked, inference accuracy increases to 95% using simple weighted voting.

data.title: Have we underestimated the total number of people on Earth?
data.author: wahern
data.article_summary: 中国农村地区的人口估算可能存在严重低估。芬兰阿尔托大学的研究人员在研究水坝建设项目导致的移民问题时，发现官方统计数据与实际人口数存在显著差异。他们分析了1980至2010年间35个国家的307个水坝项目，发现人口被低估了53%至84%。研究人员认为，低估的原因在于农村地区人口普查数据不完整以及人口估算方法更适用于城市地区。这种误差可能影响公共服务规划和全球人口统计。不过，有专家质疑研究结果，认为即便区域人口统计有误，国家或全球总人口数不会受到显著影响。研究人员建议改进普查方法和人口模型，以确保农村社区得到公平服务。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：人口过剩及其潜在后果，以及人口统计的准确性与未来预测

不同观点：
• rhakiHa认为，尽管过去预测的人口过剩灾难尚未发生，但未来仍有可能发生。他指出地球资源的有限性，并提出质量 of life会随着人口密度增加而下降，例如缺乏独处空间、学术职位竞争加剧、房租上涨等问题。他质疑地球承载力的临界点在哪里。

• nottorp对人口统计数据的准确性提出质疑，但认为有国家权威机构发放出生证明和身份证的情况下，人口统计数据不应被低估。对于中国的人口统计方式，他表示不确定。

• netsharc以幽默方式建议大家自我统计人口，并引用了一个科幻作品中的角色来增加趣味性，暗示人口统计的复杂性与难度。

• mrichman提到希拉里曾发表过地球人口不应超过5亿的言论，隐含对人口控制的讨论，但没有深入展开具体立场。

• jocoda使用细菌在封闭系统中的生长曲线作为类比，指出人类在地球这个封闭系统中也可能会经历类似的增长、稳定和衰退阶段。他强调人类有能力通过工程手段改变系统，但缺乏长期稳定的意愿，可能需要“进化”成其他形式来适应。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及到人口增长对生活质量的影响，尤其是经济和社会竞争的加剧。
• 有人对人口统计的准确性提出疑问，特别是对不同国家的人口统计方法表示不确定。
• 讨论中还提到了科幻文化中的情节，增加了讨论的趣味性和深度。
• 类比细菌生长曲线的观点提供了一种对未来人口增长的预测视角，并提出了人类通过技术改变命运的可能性。

争议焦点：
• 人口过剩是否会在未来成为严重问题，以及当前的生活质量下降是否可以直接归因于人口增长。
• 人口统计数据的准确性和各国统计方法的可靠性。

43426160.article_content:
Population estimates in rural areas of China may be incorrect
Shutterstock/aphotostory
Our estimates of rural populations have systematically underestimated the actual number of people living in these regions by at least half, researchers have claimed – with potentially huge impacts on global population levels and planning for public services. However, the findings are disputed by demographers, who say any such underestimates are unlikely to alter national or global head counts.
Josias Láng-Ritter
and his colleagues at Aalto University, Finland, were working to understand the extent to which dam construction projects caused people to be resettled, but while estimating populations, they kept getting vastly different numbers to official statistics.
Read more
How ghost cities in the Amazon are rewriting the story of civilisation

To investigate, they used data on 307 dam projects in 35 countries, including China, Brazil, Australia and Poland, all completed between 1980 and 2010, taking the number of people reported as resettled in each case as the population in that area prior to displacement. According to their analysis, the most accurate estimates undercounted the real number of people by 53 per cent on average, while the worst was 84 per cent out. “We were very surprised to see how large this underrepresentation is,” he says.

This could be done by improving censuses in such areas and recalibrating population models.
If rural population estimates are way off, that could have massive ramifications for the delivery of government services and planning, says Láng-Ritter. “The impacts may be quite huge, because these datasets are used for very many different kinds of actions,” he explains. This includes planning transport infrastructure, building healthcare facilities and risk reduction efforts in natural disasters and epidemics.

data.title: Do viruses trigger Alzheimer's?
data.author: helsinkiandrew
data.article_summary: 2024年多项研究发现，接种带状疱疹疫苗的人群患痴呆症的几率低于未接种者。斯坦福大学的研究分析了英国和澳大利亚的医疗记录，认为约五分之一的痴呆症病例可通过接种原始带状疱疹疫苗（含活病毒）来预防。此外，葛兰素史克公司和英国学者的研究显示，一种更有效的“重组”疫苗对预防痴呆症有更好效果。这些发现引发科学家思考病毒是否会触发阿尔茨海默病，以及抗病毒药物是否能治疗该疾病。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：阿尔茨海默病（AD）的病因和治疗可能性，特别是病毒在其发病机制中的潜在作用

不同观点：
• A_D_E_P_T认为Memantine和Amantadine等药物可能通过抑制病毒复制和作用于NMDA受体来治疗阿尔茨海默病，并提出Bromantane作为一种可能的补充药物。
• pedalpete指出阿尔茨海默病可能包含多种疾病，其病因可能多样，包括病毒和淀粉样蛋白假说，并强调睡眠质量与阿尔茨海默病的关联。
• zhivota认为病毒感染可能是加速衰老的重要因素，并分享了个人经历以支持这一观点。
• acallaha对一项小规模的抗病毒药物研究表示兴奋，但也表达了对研究规模和进展缓慢的担忧。
• vjk800提出病毒压力增加可能与多种现代疾病（包括阿尔茨海默病）的增加有关，并指出病毒与某些自身免疫疾病和癌症的关联。
• roenxi提醒大家注意阿尔茨海默病可能有多种原因，病毒只是其中之一，质疑病毒在阿尔茨海默病中的主要作用。
• torcete建议通过测序 deceased 患者脑组织样本验证病毒理论。
• tim333分享了一篇关于脑部微生物组的文章，强调病毒、细菌和真菌在导致痴呆中的潜在作用。
• paul_h提到“阿尔茨海默样”病症，特别是在新冠后的病例，并提供相关研究链接。
• narrator指出甲基蓝因其抗菌性和易通过血脑屏障在阿尔茨海默病研究中取得成功。
• elif批评使用问题作为标题的新闻文章，认为这可能误导公众。
• nraynaud对常见病毒与疾病之间的联系信号不明确表示惊讶，尽管统计工具先进。
• MPSFounder对阿尔茨海默病的确切病因难以确定以及治疗进展缓慢表示困惑和不满。
• SubiculumCode补充提到母体免疫过度激活可能与20%的自闭症病例有关。

补充讨论：
- 关于阿尔茨海默病是否由单一原因引起存在争议，部分评论者认为可能是多种因素共同作用。
- 病毒与阿尔茨海默病之间的潜在联系引发讨论，但具体机制和证据仍不明确。
- 不同药物和治疗方法（如Memantine、Amantadine、Bromantane、甲基蓝）的潜在疗效和机制探讨。
- 睡眠质量、疫苗接种、卫生习惯等生活方式因素在阿尔茨海默病预防中的可能作用。
- 对小规模研究和科学进展缓慢的批评与期待。

Going viral
Do viruses trigger Alzheimer’s?
A growing group of scientists think so, and are asking whether antivirals could treat the disease
Illustration: Vartika Sharma
Mar 17th 2025
Share

n the summer
of 2024 several groups of scientists published a curious finding: people vaccinated against shingles were less likely to develop dementia than their unvaccinated peers. Two of the papers came from the lab of Pascal Geldsetzer at Stanford University. Analysing medical records from Britain and Australia, the researchers concluded that around a fifth of dementia diagnoses could be averted through the original shingles vaccine, which contains live varicella-zoster virus. Two other studies, one by
GSK
, a pharmaceutical company, and another by a group of academics in Britain, also reported that a newer “recombinant” vaccine, which is more effective at preventing shingles than the live version, appeared to confer even greater protection against dementia.

data.title: Stop using the elbow criterion for k-means
data.author: Anon84
data.article_summary: 这篇文章呼吁停止在k-means聚类中使用肘部法则来选择簇数，因为该方法缺乏理论支持且容易导致错误结论。作者指出，学术界应采用其他已被广泛认可的替代方法，如轮廓系数、差距统计等。文章建议教育工作者避免教授肘部法则，并鼓励研究人员和审稿人拒绝基于该方法得出的结论。通过这样做，可以提高聚类分析的准确性和可靠性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于K-means及其相关聚类方法（如Elbow方法、HDBScan等）的有效性和使用场景的讨论

不同观点：
• **支持Elbow方法的理论基础**：whatshisface认为Elbow方法有其简单的理论依据，如果数据有k个完全分离的簇，那么分割不同簇的收益应该明显大于分割同一簇的收益。如果不能看到这种现象，说明数据本身就没有完全分离的簇。

• **对论文标题的批评**：joshdavham批评了某些论文的标题风格，认为它们像点击诱饵式的YouTube视频标题，尤其是“停止做[传统的事]”这种格式令他感到特别反感。

• **推荐其他聚类方法**：djoldman认为像Calinski和Harabasz的方差比率标准（VRC）、贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）或Gap统计等方法应优先考虑。他还指出，聚类算法本质上是无监督的，因此没有所谓的“正确答案”，实际应用场景通常决定了哪种算法（如k-means、DBSCAN等）和参数最为合适。

• **对停止使用K-means的反对**：jb1991认为停止使用K-means的建议有点像是一种情绪化的反应。

• **支持Silhouette方法**：tetris11表示自己经常使用Silhouette方法，因为它生成的图很酷，尽管在K=1时表现不佳，但在K较大时表现良好。

• **对聚类任务的定义质疑**：esafak认为聚类任务本身定义不清，如何定义“簇”存在问题，尤其是通过欧氏距离进行分离并不具备尺度不变性。他认为聚类方法和表示应根据下游任务进行优化。

• **K-means在实际应用中的成功案例**：egberts1指出，信用卡欺诈检测部门大量使用K-means中的“hockey-sticks”方法，表明K-means在某些特定领域仍然非常有效。

• **Elbow方法在实践中的问题**：rgavuliak根据自己十多年的经验表示，Elbow方法在实践中从未很好地发挥作用，他从未看到数据在图表中出现显著分离。

• **对K-means统计假设的提醒**：pbronez指出，论文中提到K-means是高斯混合模型的一种特例，它对数据做了很多假设，因此理解模型背后的统计假设至关重要。

• **停止使用K-means的强烈呼吁**：bbstats和Der_Einzige都呼吁停止使用K-means，后者特别推荐了GPU实现的HDBScan，尤其是在A100s上，认为其在处理非常大的数据集时表现更优越。

补充讨论：
- K-means及其替代方法（如HDBScan、GMM等）在不同应用场景中的有效性成为讨论的焦点。
- 关于Elbow方法的有效性存在争议，部分用户认为其理论基础简单明确，但在实践中效果不佳。
- 对聚类算法的选择应基于具体应用场景和下游任务的需求，而不是简单依赖某种方法。
- 对论文标题风格的批评虽然与技术讨论无关，但也反映了部分读者对学术论文标题风格的看法。

Title:
Stop using the elbow criterion for k-means and how to choose the number of clusters instead
Authors:
Erich Schubert
View a PDF of the paper titled Stop using the elbow criterion for k-means and how to choose the number of clusters instead, by Erich Schubert
View PDF
Abstract:
A major challenge when using k-means clustering often is how to choose the parameter k, the number of clusters. In this letter, we want to point out that it is very easy to draw poor conclusions from a common heuristic, the "elbow method". Better alternatives have been known in literature for a long time, and we want to draw attention to some of these easy to use options, that often perform better. This letter is a call to stop using the elbow method altogether, because it severely lacks theoretic support, and we want to encourage educators to discuss the problems of the method -- if introducing it in class at all -- and teach alternatives instead, while researchers and reviewers should reject conclusions drawn from the elbow method.

43450550.article_summary: 这篇文章呼吁停止在k-means聚类中使用肘部法则来选择簇数，因为该方法缺乏理论支持且容易导致错误结论。作者指出，学术界应采用其他已被广泛认可的替代方法，如轮廓系数、差距统计等。文章建议教育工作者避免教授肘部法则，并鼓励研究人员和审稿人拒绝基于该方法得出的结论。通过这样做，可以提高聚类分析的准确性和可靠性。
43450550.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于K-means及其相关聚类方法（如Elbow方法、HDBScan等）的有效性和使用场景的讨论

不同观点：
• **支持Elbow方法的理论基础**：whatshisface认为Elbow方法有其简单的理论依据，如果数据有k个完全分离的簇，那么分割不同簇的收益应该明显大于分割同一簇的收益。如果不能看到这种现象，说明数据本身就没有完全分离的簇。

• **对论文标题的批评**：joshdavham批评了某些论文的标题风格，认为它们像点击诱饵式的YouTube视频标题，尤其是“停止做[传统的事]”这种格式令他感到特别反感。

• **推荐其他聚类方法**：djoldman认为像Calinski和Harabasz的方差比率标准（VRC）、贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）或Gap统计等方法应优先考虑。他还指出，聚类算法本质上是无监督的，因此没有所谓的“正确答案”，实际应用场景通常决定了哪种算法（如k-means、DBSCAN等）和参数最为合适。

• **对停止使用K-means的反对**：jb1991认为停止使用K-means的建议有点像是一种情绪化的反应。

• **支持Silhouette方法**：tetris11表示自己经常使用Silhouette方法，因为它生成的图很酷，尽管在K=1时表现不佳，但在K较大时表现良好。

• **对聚类任务的定义质疑**：esafak认为聚类任务本身定义不清，如何定义“簇”存在问题，尤其是通过欧氏距离进行分离并不具备尺度不变性。他认为聚类方法和表示应根据下游任务进行优化。

• **K-means在实际应用中的成功案例**：egberts1指出，信用卡欺诈检测部门大量使用K-means中的“hockey-sticks”方法，表明K-means在某些特定领域仍然非常有效。

• **Elbow方法在实践中的问题**：rgavuliak根据自己十多年的经验表示，Elbow方法在实践中从未很好地发挥作用，他从未看到数据在图表中出现显著分离。

• **对K-means统计假设的提醒**：pbronez指出，论文中提到K-means是高斯混合模型的一种特例，它对数据做了很多假设，因此理解模型背后的统计假设至关重要。

• **停止使用K-means的强烈呼吁**：bbstats和Der_Einzige都呼吁停止使用K-means，后者特别推荐了GPU实现的HDBScan，尤其是在A100s上，认为其在处理非常大的数据集时表现更优越。

补充讨论：
- K-means及其替代方法（如HDBScan、GMM等）在不同应用场景中的有效性成为讨论的焦点。
- 关于Elbow方法的有效性存在争议，部分用户认为其理论基础简单明确，但在实践中效果不佳。
- 对聚类算法的选择应基于具体应用场景和下游任务的需求，而不是简单依赖某种方法。
- 对论文标题风格的批评虽然与技术讨论无关，但也反映了部分读者对学术论文标题风格的看法。

data.title: Can people be persuaded not to believe disinformation?
data.author: helsinkiandrew
data.article_summary: 文章讨论了如何说服人们不轻信虚假信息，尤其是在社交媒体和政治极化使真相与阴谋论界限模糊的当下。例子包括关于美国国际开发署向加沙地带运送价值5000万美元避孕套等不实传闻。文章指出，"揭伪学"（Debunkology）旨在破解人们根深蒂固的错误信念，但进展缓慢。可能的解决方案包括使用AI聊天机器人和开设批判性思维课程，以帮助人们识别和抵制虚假信息。文章强调，面对现代信息环境的挑战，这些措施或能有效减少人们对虚假信息的轻信。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何有效说服与影响公众意见，以及是否应尊重公众的理性能力。

不同观点：
• **matrix87** 认为，将人们视为需要被引导的群体，采用居高临下的态度和方法是政治上的失败策略。这种方法不仅无效，而且由于自我（ego）作祟，政客们更倾向于保持这种姿态，而不是真正与选民接触。他强调尊重选民的重要性，而不是简单地试图操纵或说服他们。

• **goreil** 引用了研究结果，指出通过与GPT-4对话可以显著减弱参与者对某些信念的坚定性，且在TikTok上，伴随快节奏音乐的辟谣信息更有效。这表明高科技工具和特定传播手段可能有效影响公众意见。

• **thinkingemote** 回顾了近100年前成立的宣传分析研究所的历史，指出当时的目标是教育公众认识宣传手段，并赋予他们批判性思维的能力。他认为，现代许多政治机构和“受过教育”的人将大众视为可塑的、缺乏思考能力的群体，这种态度不仅会导致对他人尊严的漠视，还会增加自己被操纵的风险。

补充讨论：
• **争议的焦点** 在于如何看待公众的理性能力。matrix87和thinkingemote都认为，尊重公众的理性能力和批判性思维是关键，而现代许多说服策略似乎低估了公众的智力水平。

• **方法的有效性** 是另一个值得注意的讨论点。goreil引用的研究显示，现代技术（如GPT-4）和特定传播策略（如快节奏音乐）可能在改变信念方面具有一定效果，但matrix87和thinkingemote则质疑这些方法的道德性和长期有效性。

• **历史视角** 提供了对当前问题的深刻见解。thinkingemote通过历史案例指出，宣传和说服手段长期以来一直是控制和影响公众行为的重要工具，但如何平衡说服与尊重公众的理性能力是一个持续的挑战。

总结来说，评论讨论了说服策略的有效性和道德性，以及如何平衡技术手段与公众教育之间的关系。争议的核心在于对公众理性能力的不同看法。

Debunkology
Can people be persuaded not to believe disinformation?
AI chatbots and critical thinking courses might help
Illustration: George Wylesol
Mar 19th 2025
Share
A
nyone following
American politics in recent months will have been treated to their fair share of bogus claims:
USAID
, the country’s main development agency, sent $50m worth of condoms to the Gaza Strip; tens of millions of deceased centenarians are continuing to receive social-security payments; disaster-relief funding was spent on housing migrants in luxury hotels in New York City. That so many people believe them nonetheless highlights how an age of social media and political polarisation has blurred the lines between truth and conspiracy theory. Debunkology, or how to unpick beliefs once they take root in people’s brains, is struggling to catch up.

data.title: Big Tech is striking secret deals to make you foot its electricity bill
data.author: zekrioca
data.article_summary: 哈佛大学研究人员发现，大型科技公司正与电力公司达成秘密协议，可能导致普通美国人电费上涨。数据中心用电量预计到2028年将占美国电力的12%，而这些公司通过隐藏合同细节获得电力折扣，可能让其他用户承担电网升级费用。目前，这些合同缺乏透明度和公众监督，研究人员呼吁加强监管以保护消费者利益。尽管科技公司声称会承担全部成本，但研究表明，居民可能仍面临每月额外14至37美元的电费。专家建议对特殊合同进行更严格审查，以防止不公平的成本转移。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：大型科技公司获取电力的方式及其对公众的影响

不同观点：
• [xvokcarts的观点] 大科技公司正在通过谈判获取电力，这本身是可以预料的商业行为。然而，问题在于这些公司与电力供应商达成的协议让公众承担了部分成本，这是不合理的。重点在于大科技公司通过谈判获得电力供应，但公众却在补贴这些电力交易。

• [ekianjo的观点] 如果大科技公司使用的是公共基础设施，那么相关的合同应该公开透明，以防止通过保密条款让纳税人承担不必要的成本。ekianjo强调了合同公开的必要性，以防止不公平的交易和潜在的纳税人利益受损。

补充讨论：
• xvokcarts指出大科技公司通过与电力供应商谈判获得电力，并且这些协议通常由公众补贴，这暗示了现行制度中的不公平现象。
• ekianjo进一步提出透明度问题，认为如果涉及到公共基础设施，合同必须公开，以防止通过保密条款损害公众利益。
• 争议的焦点在于大科技公司获取电力的协议是否应该公开，以及公众是否在不知情的情况下补贴了这些交易。

总结：讨论围绕大科技公司获取电力的方式及其对公众的影响展开，一方关注协议的不公平性，另一方则关注合同的透明度以保护公众利益。

Big Tech's secretive electricity deals with utilities may raise costs for Americans, Harvard researchers reported.
Data centers could consume 12% of US electricity by 2028, up from 4% in 2023.
Researchers call for more scrutiny of contracts to protect consumers from higher bills.
Tech companies racing to
secure power for their data centers
have struck dozens of secretive electricity deals with utilities that could cost average Americans a "staggering" amount, Harvard research found.
With data center construction on the rise and
utility costs top-of-mind for many Americans
, the Harvard Electricity Law Initiative
reviewed 40
special contracts that state regulators have approved between utilities and data centers. If these contracts offer discounted electricity rates to data centers, and new power grid infrastructure is needed to serve them, other customers may end up paying for the shortfall through higher utility bills.
But it's nearly impossible to know the exact price tag of any cost shifts because the terms of these special contracts are hidden from public view, the report found. State regulators usually approve utilities' requests for confidentiality, limiting public scrutiny. That means billion-dollar contracts are getting approved without a transparent accounting of the costs and benefits, researchers said.
"When we have potentially billions of dollars going through these secret contracts where there's just not a lot of investigation about what's going on, we think there's reason to be suspicious that utilities may be offering discounts that are subsidized by everybody else," said Ari Peskoe, director of The Harvard Electricity Law Initiative and coauthor of the paper with Eliza Martin, a legal fellow.
The report lands as
data center construction is booming
, in part to serve Big Tech's artificial intelligence race. Some AI data center complexes need
as much power as entire cities
and by 2028, the industry could account for 12% of US electricity consumption — up from 4% in 2023, according to federal estimates. The trend is leading some citizens, state policymakers, and at least one utility to try to
shield households from rising bills
.
Utilities and tech companies have
told Business Insider
that the contracts they negotiate should cover the costs of any power grid upgrades required to serve data centers. Lucas Fykes, director of energy policy for the Data Center Coalition, which represents companies including Amazon Web Services, Google, Microsoft, and Meta, said in an emailed statement that the industry is committed to paying its full cost of service.
Fykes added that the Harvard research overlooks a finding in
Virginia — the world's largest data center market
— that the industry is paying the appropriate costs for its energy use. In December, an
independent study commissioned by
Virginia's Joint Legislative Audit and Review Commission found that rates "appropriately allocate costs to the customers responsible for incurring them, including data center customers."
The report also said that data centers' increased energy demand will likely increase costs for everyone, including residents and businesses. A large amount of new power plants and transmission lines will be built that otherwise wouldn't be needed, if not for data centers. A typical residential customer in Virginia could see an extra $14 to $37 each month on their utility bill by 2040. The report said creating a separate category for data centers and changing the way costs are allocated across customers could help insulate households from statewide cost increases.
Peskoe recommended greater scrutiny and regulation of special contracts, as well.
"We didn't realize how extensive these secret contracts were," Peskoe said. "The more we dug, the more we kept finding."
Regulators are required to protect the public from 'cutthroat' practices. Researchers are skeptical.
State and federal regulators allow most utilities to spread the cost of power grid upgrades across their customer base. This is typically done through what's known as a rate case increase, a lengthy and public process at state public utility commissions. Consumer advocates, environmental and industrial groups, and other outside parties regularly intervene.
By contrast, most of the special contracts that Peskoe and Martin reviewed were approved by public utility commissions with "only cursory analysis" and little or no public evidence to back up claims that data center energy costs

• ekianjo进一步提出透明度问题，认为如果涉及到公共基础设施，合同必须公开，以防止通过保密条款损害公众利益。
• 争议的焦点在于大科技公司获取电力的协议是否应该公开，以及公众是否在不知情的情况下补贴了这些交易。

总结：讨论围绕大科技公司获取电力的方式及其对公众的影响展开，一方关注协议的不公平性，另一方则关注合同的透明度以保护公众利益。

data.title: Lock Contention
data.author: stacyz
data.article_summary: 本文总结了一次ClickHouse中的锁竞争问题的调查过程。2022年，Tinybird的一个集群在高峰期出现CPU利用率低下的问题，尽管没有IO、网络或内存瓶颈，且ClickHouse的异步指标和查询性能事件正常。问题持续一年未解，直到发现异步指标`ContextLockWait`偶尔增加，表明线程在等待`Context`锁。通过定期转储线程堆栈，发现多数线程在`Context`类的锁等待中阻塞，如`Context::getSettings()`。为解决此问题，作者在ClickHouse中添加了`ContextLockWaitMicroseconds`指标，用于测量线程等待`Context`锁的时间，类似于已有的全局线程池锁等待指标。该指标帮助识别并解决了`Context`锁竞争问题。

主要讨论点：[对bug修复的奉献精神以及对不同工具和编程语言的体验]

不同观点：
• [IshKebab的观点] 认为作者在bug修复方面的努力值得称赞，并分享了自己过去尝试使用线程消毒器（thread sanitizer）但因TBB（Intel Threading Building Blocks）原语不支持而放弃的经历。该评论者对目前只在Rust中进行多线程编程感到满意。

补充讨论：
• 提到了线程消毒器的局限性，特别是在与TBB一起使用时遇到的支持问题。
• 强调了Rust在多线程编程中的优势，暗示Rust可能提供了更好的开发体验和工具支持。
• 隐含的争议焦点可能是不同编程语言和工具在多线程开发中的适用性和易用性，尤其是与调试工具有关的兼容性问题。

43390401.article_content:
Overview
Recently, I revisited
Resolving a year-long ClickHouse lock contention
post and spoke about it
at C++ Russia 2025 conference.
I wanted to provide more information about the development process and some technical details that were not covered in the original post.
Motivation
In 2022 in Tinybird, there was a huge CPU underutilization in one of our clusters during the high load period.
It was unclear what was the issue. There were no IO/Network/Memory bottlenecks. In ClickHouse all async metrics and query profile events were normal.
The only unusual thing was that with increased queries throughput, ClickHouse could not handle the load, and CPU usage was very low.
The problem continued for a year and during similar incidents, we could not find any clues.
One year later during a similar incident, we spotted that
ContextLockWait
async metric periodically increased.
Async metrics
are calculated periodically with some interval and include for example memory usage, and some global metrics. Client can read them using
system.asynchronous_metrics
table. And one of such metrics is
ContextLockWait
, it tells you how many threads are waiting for a
Context
lock.
It is normal that during high load such metric can increase because of increased contention on
Context
lock. But it was very unusual because the normal value of this metric is around
0
, so I started to investigate the issue from the ClickHouse internals side.
During the incident, I periodically dumped all threads stack traces to understand how many threads were blocked on lock inside
Context
. It is possible to dump all threads stack traces in ClickHouse using
system.stack_trace
table and the following query:
WITH arrayMap(x -> demangle(addressToSymbol(x)), trace) AS all
SELECT thread_name, thread_id, query_id, arrayStringConcat(all, '\n') AS res
FROM
system.stack_trace
LIMIT 1 FORMAT Vertical;
Row 1:
ââââââ
thread_name: clickhouse-serv
thread_id:   125441
query_id:
res:         pthread_cond_wait
std::__1::condition_variable::wait(std::__1::unique_lock<std::__1::mutex>&)
BaseDaemon::waitForTerminationRequest()
DB::Server::main(/*arguments*/)
Poco::Util::Application::run()
DB::Server::run()
Poco::Util::ServerApplication::run(int, char**)
mainEntryClickHouseServer(int, char**)
main
__libc_start_main
_start
Every 10-15 seconds I dumped all threads stack traces to later check if there were any patterns where threads were spending time. After the incident, I was able to see that most of the threads were blocked on
Context
class methods that needed to take a
Context
lock, for example
Context::getSettings()
.
After that I was almost sure that the problem was in
Context
lock contention and started to investigate this particular lock.
Adding ContextLockWaitMicroseconds
In ClickHouse there are per query profile events that are defined like this:
M(
GlobalThreadPoolJobs
,
"Counts the number of jobs that have been pushed to the global thread pool.",
ValueType::Number) \
M(
GlobalThreadPoolLockWaitMicroseconds
,
"Total time threads have spent waiting for locks in the global thread pool.",
ValueType::Microseconds) \
M(
GlobalThreadPoolJobWaitTimeMicroseconds
,
"Measures the elapsed time from when a job is scheduled in the thread pool to when it is picked up
for execution by a worker thread. This metric helps identify delays in job processing, indicating
the responsiveness of the thread pool to new tasks.",
ValueType::Microseconds) \
M(
LocalThreadPoolLockWaitMicroseconds
,
"Total time threads have spent waiting for locks in the local thread pools.",
ValueType::Microseconds) \
As you can see they can have different types like
ValueType::Number
or
ValueType::Microseconds
. We already have a lot of metrics for locks for which we can have heavy contention. For example,
you can see that there is
GlobalThreadPoolLockWaitMicroseconds
event that allows you to see how much time threads spend waiting for locks in the global thread pool. Unfortunately,
for
Context
lock we did not have a similar metric, we only had
ContextLock
event that tells you how many times the
Context
lock was acquired or tried to acquire. It is not enough to
understand if there is a problem with
Context
lock contention, because it is expected that query can take this lock many times during query execution to read query settings, query current database, etc. We need a metric that tells us how much time threads in the query spend waiting for a
Context
lock, similar to the
GlobalThreadPoolLockWaitMicroseconds
event.
The first step was to add the
ContextLockWaitMicroseconds
event to profile events in
https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/55029
:
M(ContextLock,
"Number of times the lock of Context was acquired or tried to acquire. This is global lock.",
ValueType::Number) \
M(
ContextLockWaitMicroseconds
,
"Context lock wait time in microseconds",
ValueType::Microseconds) \

data.title: I want a good parallel computer
data.author: raphlinus
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了为何GPU尽管在图形渲染和机器学习等任务中非常强大，却未能成为更通用的计算工具。主要原因有两点：一是GPU的执行模型不够完善，难以高效处理动态工作负载；二是缺乏合适的编程语言和工具，使得并行计算编程更加困难。此外，现代GPU日益复杂，新功能如网格着色器和工作图虽然增加了能力，但也带来了新的限制。作者以Vello渲染器为例，说明了GPU在处理中间数据结构时面临的内存管理问题，并指出当前的GPU执行模型无法有效支持在有限内存中运行复杂算法。文章还回顾了历史上一些有潜力的并行计算机设计，但这些设计因各种原因未能普及，导致如今的GPU既复杂又受限。作者呼吁简化并行计算机设计，使其更强大并适用于更广泛的任务。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：多核并行计算架构的潜力和挑战，特别是Epiphany-V等高核心数处理器的可行性、编程模型、应用场景以及与GPU的比较。

不同观点：
• **Epiphany-V和高核心数处理器的军事应用**：muziq对Epiphany-V处理器被用于军事系统表示担忧，认为其DARPA背景可能限制了其在普通用户中的可用性。

• **历史架构的局限性和现代系统的优势**：deviantbit认为现代系统在稳定性、内存保护和隔离方面有显著改进，批评一些人对过时架构的怀旧情绪，并建议让学生在旧系统上编写代码以增强对现代系统的理解。

• **GPU编程模型的复杂性**：grg0指出GPU编程模型存在的问题，包括运行时编译、数据复制、同步问题、API不标准化以及配置复杂性，希望有一种更统一的计算模型。

• **CDN服务器应用的潜力**：eternityforest提出在每个核心上拥有硬件TCP/TLS栈和内置IP路由器的可能性，以用于CDN服务器应用。

• **新架构的失败原因和GPU的未来**：IshKebab认为高核心数处理器由于奇怪的编程模型和缺乏软件支持将失败，未来更可能由具有额外功能的GPU主导。

• **逆向工程和自定义编译器的可行性**：morphle讨论了逆向工程Apple M3 Ultra GPU和神经引擎的可能性，以释放其并行计算潜力，并计划进行性能基准测试。

• **技术和社区支持的重要性**：dekhn强调技术和社区支持对新设备成功的重要性，指出即使技术优越，缺乏社区支持也可能导致失败，并提到AMD在将GPU更紧密地集成到CPU方面的尝试。

• **GPU在非图形任务中的应用**：armchairhacker认为GPU在许多任务中并不必要，因为现有CPU已经足够快，且GPU编程复杂性高，主张简化GPU编程以主要用于图形和机器学习任务。

• **3D渲染中的GPU利用和挑战**：Animats讨论了在3D渲染中利用GPU的复杂性，指出在场景复杂度增加时渲染效率的问题，并提出需要更好的解决方案来处理渲染器和调用者之间的信息交换。

• **历史并行计算设备的比较**：Quis_sum通过对比CM2设备，指出其与现代高核心数处理器设计和操作方式的不同。

• **GPU高吞吐量的代价**：ip26认为GPU高吞吐量的代价是动态工作负载的困难，这是GPU设计中的一个基本权衡。

• **FPGA原型的潜力**：scroot提到uFork和FPGA原型，认为这是并行计算的一个潜在方向。

• **统一内存架构的利用**：Retr0id对苹果芯片的统一内存架构在GPU编程中的优势表示赞赏，但指出当前API并没有充分利用这一特性。

• **von Neumann架构的局限性**：svmhdvn和mikewarot指出尝试并行化von Neumann架构的局限性，认为其程序计数器和地址空间的特性限制了可扩展性。

补充讨论：
• **技术和市场需求的关系**：dekhn提到技术和市场需求之间的相互作用，指出即使技术上优越的设备也可能因为市场需求不足而失败。

• **开源项目的挑战**：Animats提到在Rust 3D渲染器开发中的挑战，指出许多项目在遇到复杂场景时失败或放弃。

争议焦点：
• **高核心数处理器的可行性和编程模型的优劣**：不同参与者对高核心数处理器的编程模型和市场可行性存在分歧，一些人认为其编程模型过于复杂且缺乏软件支持，而另一些人则认为其在特定应用中具有潜力。

43440174.article_content:
The GPU in your computer is about 10 to 100 times more powerful than the CPU, depending on workload. For real-time graphics rendering and machine learning, you are enjoying that power, and doing those workloads on a CPU is not viable. Why aren’t we exploiting that power for other workloads? What prevents a GPU from being a more general purpose computer?
I believe there are two main things holding it back. One is an impoverished execution model, which makes certain tasks difficult or impossible to do efficiently; GPUs excel at big blocks of data with predictable shape, such as dense matrix multiplication, but struggle when the workload is dynamic. Second, our languages and tools are inadequate. Programming a parallel computer is just a lot harder.
Modern GPUs are also extremely complex, and getting more so rapidly. New features such as mesh shaders and work graphs are two steps forward one step back; for each new capability there is a basic task that isn’t fully supported.
I believe a simpler, more powerful parallel computer is possible, and that there are signs in the historical record. In a slightly alternate universe, we would have those computers now, and be doing the work of designing algorithms and writing programs to run well on them, for a very broad range of tasks.
Last April, I gave a
colloquium
(video) at the UCSC CSE program with the same title. This blog is a companion to that.
Memory efficiency of sophisticated GPU programs
I’ve been working on
Vello
, an advanced 2D vector graphics renderer, for many years. The CPU uploads a scene description in a simplified binary SVG-like format, then the compute shaders take care of the rest, producing a 2D rendered image at the end. The compute shaders
parse
tree structures, do advanced computational geometry for
stroke expansion
, and sorting-like algorithms for binning. Internally, it’s essentially a simple compiler, producing a separate optimized byte-code like program for each 16x16 pixel tile, then interpreting those programs. What it cannot do, a problem I am increasingly frustrated by, is run in bounded memory. Each stage produces intermediate data structures, and the number and size of these structures depends on the input in an unpredictable way. For example, changing a single transform in the encoded scene can result in profoundly different rendering plans.
The problem is that the buffers for the intermediate results need to be allocated (under CPU control) before kicking off the pipeline. There are a number of imperfect potential solutions. We could estimate memory requirements on the CPU before starting a render, but that’s expensive and may not be precise, resulting either in failure or waste. We could try a render, detect failure, and retry if buffers were exceeded, but doing readback from GPU to CPU is a big performance problem, and creates a significant architectural burden on other engines we’d interface with.
The details of the specific problem are interesting but beyond the scope of this blog post. The interested reader is directed to the
Potato
design document, which explores the question of how far you can get doing scheduling on CPU, respecting bounded GPU resources, while using the GPU for actual pixel wrangling. It also touches on several more recent extensions to the standard GPU execution model, all of which are complex and non-portable, and none of which quite seem to solve the problem.
Fundamentally, it shouldn’t be necessary to allocate large buffers to store intermediate results. Since they will be consumed by downstream stages, it’s far more efficient to put them in queues, sized large enough to keep enough items in flight to exploit available parallelism. Many GPU operations internally work as queues (the standard vertex shader / fragment shader / rasterop pipeline being the classic example), so it’s a question of exposing that underlying functionality to applications. The
GRAMPS
paper from 2009 suggests this direction, as did the
Brook
project, a predecessor to CUDA.
There are a lot of potential solutions to running Vello-like algorithms in bounded memory; most have a fatal flaw on hardware today. It’s interesting to speculate about changes that would unlock the capability. It’s worth emphasizing, I’m not feeling held back by the amount of parallelism I can exploit, as my approach of breaking the problem into variants of prefix sum easily scales to hundreds of thousands of threads. Rather, it’s the inability to organize the overall as stages operating in parallel, connected through queues tuned to use only the amount of buffer memory needed to keep everything smoothly, as opposed to the compute shader execution model of large dispatches separated by pipeline barriers.
Parallel computers of the past
The lack of a good parallel computer today is especially frustrating because there were some promising designs in the past, which failed to catch on for various complex reasons, leaving us with overly complex and limited GPUs, an

data.article_summary: Hadrius正在招聘创始软件工程师和技术主管，工作地点在纽约，薪资范围为20万至24万美元，另加0.25%至0.75%的股权。该岗位要求3年以上经验，需在高速成长的初创环境中快速工作，并直接与创始团队合作，设计和构建金融系统。职责包括在第一周推送首个生产PR，理解核心问题和产品路线图，并在后续几个月中开发新功能、解决扩展挑战以及培训新成员。要求4年以上软件工程经验，具备解决问题的能力和良好的沟通技巧，熟悉React和Django者优先。公司提供401k匹配、健康保险和住房津贴等福利。面试过程包括技术测试、文化契合度评估和领导力面试，目标在5-8个工作日内做出招聘决定。Hadrius利用AI分析数据以识别合规问题，目前服务于管理超过4000亿美元资产的100多家金融机构，是YC孵化的高增长公司。

Allen Calderwood
Founder
About the role
This is a full-time role to be a Founding Software Engineer and Technical Lead, located onsite in New York, NY.
About you
You have concrete career goals. We expect you to help us hit our goals, so you also expect us to help you reach yours - without clear goals, there’s a fundamental misalignment for success.
You move fast and expect your teammates to move quickly too. We’ve entered a phase of growth where there is more work to do than there are people to do it - this means everyone on the team will be extremely busy, but there are also countless opportunities to grow personally and make progress towards your goals.
You have a high quality bar for your work. As we scale our teams and customer base up, the expectations of our software rises with it.
You’re looking for teammates, not coworkers - folks you can lean on to help make your goals possible while at Hadrius, and beyond.
About the role
You will work directly with the founding team to design and build the future of the financial system from the ground floor of a high growth startup. We pride ourselves on having a hands off culture by having very few meetings and giving engineers a broad scope of responsibility and autonomy. You’ll be working in-person 5 days/week in our NYC FiDi office, building side-by-side with the rest of the team. Our tech stack is django/python, react/next/typescript, hosted on AWS.
Responsibilities
First week:
Day 1: push your first PR to production
Understand the core problems Hadrius solves, our ICP, our value proposition, the Hadrius platform, pricing structure, and roadmap
Learn the Hadrius way: how we work and build for high growth
Get up to speed on the codebase
Contribute to product discussions in weekly all hands
First month:
Implement a big feature that directly leads to new revenue for the business
Standing out on the team in sheer contribution
Helping others through code-review and technical design reviews
First 3 months & beyond:
Continuing to develop the above skillset, paying special attention to scaling challenges and stability as we bring on more and more clients.
Training and hiring new team members to take over your code as you scale your impact across the team
Qualifications
4+ years of professional experience as a software engineer
Clear communicator with a penchant for solving problems
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field
Nice to haves
Previous experience in a fast-paced startup environment
Experience working in a mature React codebase in production
Experience working in a mature Django/Python codebase in production
Benefits
401k (100% match up to 6%)
Healthcare, dental, vision, etc.
Housing stipend if you live in FiDi
About the interview
20 minute phone screen:
Details on the role, questions to assess initial fit
60 minute technical:
Programming and system design
2x 30 minute culture fit calls with founders:
In-depth assessment of your drivers, work ethic, goals, and more to determine mutual fit.
30 minute leadership interview:
We’ll discuss some of your past experiences as a lead
On-site:
Meet the rest of the team
Offer
End to end we aim for a decision in 5-8 business days.
About
Hadrius
Hadrius will prevent the next financial crisis. To do this, we’re building the automated back office for financial firms, using AI to analyze millions of data points from emails to text messages, marketing copy, investment accounts, filings, and more to identify regulatory violations.
Today, over 100+ financial institutions managing $400B+ AUM rely on Hadrius to automate their regulatory compliance. We’re the fastest growing company in the space, going from our launch out of the YC W23 batch to $1.5m+ ARR in under 12 months and haven’t slowed down since. We have a world-class team and product competing against legacy software that hasn't innovated in decades. The only thing that can stop us now is the team we cultivate, so we’re looking for exceptional, mission-driven people dedicated to our shared mission.
We’re backed by tier 1 VCs and doubling our revenue every 3 months.

data.title: The case of the critical section that let multiple threads enter a block of code
data.author: luu
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对微软C代码质量及其技术选择的批评与讨论

不同观点：
• **对微软代码风格的批评**：
  - [robmccoll] 认为微软的C代码难以阅读，尤其是括号位置、没有换行、命名惯例和通过typedef隐藏指针等问题让他感到不适。
  - [putzdown] 进一步批评微软代码不仅丑陋、不透明，而且通过糟糕的系统和想法解决问题，最终导致更多不必要的调试工作。他认为微软的成功仅仅是凭借其市场地位，而非代码质量。

• **具体技术实现问题的讨论**：
  - [davydm] 提到一个具体的bug案例，即一个懒初始化函数在每次调用时重新初始化了关键部分，指出了代码实现中的实际问题。
  - [tialaramex] 对使用SRWLock和关键部分的必要性提出了质疑，认为微软选择的技术过于复杂，本应有更简单的互斥锁（mutex）实现。他还提供了在现代系统中使用类似Linux futex的替代方案。

• **类型系统的讨论**：
  - [akoboldfrying] 讨论了C语言中类型系统的问题，尤其是返回类型使用不当可能导致错误。他建议为每个组件定义自己的结果类型（如FooResult），以避免意外错误，同时提供了一个具体的实现示例，尽管承认在C中无法完全防止未初始化变量的问题。

• **对Windows API设计的不满**：
  - [hyperhello] 批评Windows平台上回调函数和API设计不一致，尤其是对成功和错误的返回值处理（如有的地方0表示成功，有的地方则不然），增加了用户的理解负担。

• **对简化设计的呼吁**：
  - [xyzzy9563] 认为代码实现不需要过于复杂，建议使用强类型和互斥锁，强调问题本质上并不复杂。

• **对微软平台的整体否定**：
  - [ddtaylor] 直接表示对Windows平台没有兴趣，并积极引导客户远离Windows，认为微软对大多数用户没有价值。

补充讨论：
- 评论中多次提到了微软代码复杂性和技术选择的争议，尤其是使用SRWLock而不是简单的mutex，以及C语言类型系统的局限性。
- 不同评论者对微软整体技术栈和API设计的批评集中在设计不一致和不必要的复杂性上。
- 争议的焦点在于微软代码的可读性、实现复杂性和API设计的合理性，部分评论者甚至对微软平台本身提出了质疑。

data.title: The Barnacle Goose Myth
data.author: jamesgpearce
data.article_summary: 《 barnacle goose 神话》讲述的是关于灰雁（Branta leucopsis）和黑雁（Branta bernicla）繁殖习性的历史误解。该神话声称这些雁从藤壶（Cirripedia）中完全成形而出，或其他非蛋生的方式生成。该神话源于对鸟类迁徙模式的无知，并在中世纪通过修道院手稿和动物寓言集传播。早期文献如11世纪的《埃克塞特书》中的谜语也提及此神话。19世纪末，鸟类迁徙研究才揭示这些雁迁徙到格陵兰或北欧繁殖。有学者如Ray Lankester认为，公元前1600-1100年间的迈锡尼定居者可能已经知道此神话，并通过陶器上的绘画表现出来，展示了藤壶与雁的关联。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：日本都市传说的真实性及其衍生话题（关于藤壶的讨论）

不同观点：
• [usagisushi的观点] 认为这是一个 creepy（令人毛骨悚然的）日本都市神话。他描述了故事的内容：一个人在沙滩上弄伤膝盖后，医生发现他的髌骨里长出了藤壶。他还提到，这样的故事可能并不会让人起鸡皮疙瘩（goosebump-less）。

• [DrNosferatu的观点] 没有直接讨论都市传说的真实性，而是转而谈论藤壶的美味，尤其是新鲜的藤壶。这似乎是在用幽默的方式回应前者的评论，将话题从都市传说的恐怖感转移到食物上。

补充讨论：
• 第一个评论集中于都市传说的内容及其带来的心理感受（ creepy, goosebump-less）。
• 第二个评论则偏离了恐怖感，引入了与食物相关的话题，制造了一种意外的转折。
• 两者之间的讨论焦点并不完全一致，前者关注传说的惊悚性，而后者关注传说的某个元素（藤壶）在现实中的属性（可食用性）。
• 争议的焦点可能在于对都市传说的态度：一个是认真对待其惊悚效果，另一个则是轻松看待并引入现实生活中的元素。

43431881.article_content:
From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
Sources of ancient myth
From Topographia Hibernica British Library MS 13 B VIII (
c.
1188 CE
)
The
barnacle goose myth
is a widely-reported historical misconception about the breeding habits of the
barnacle goose
(
Branta leucopsis
) and
brant goose
(
Branta bernicla
).
[
1
]
One version of the myth is that these geese emerge fully formed from
goose barnacles
(
Cirripedia
).
[
2
]
Other myths exist about how the barnacle goose supposedly emerges and grows from matter other than bird eggs.
The etymology of the term "barnacle" suggests  Latin, Old English, and French roots.
[
3
]
There are few references in pre-Christian books and manuscripts – some Roman or Greek. The main vector for the myth into modern times was monastic manuscripts and in particular the
bestiary
.
[
4
]
The myth owes its long-standing popularity to an early ignorance of the migration patterns of geese. Early medieval discussions of the nature of living organisms were often based on myths or genuine ignorance of what is now known about phenomena such as
bird migration
. It was not until the late 19th century that bird migration research showed that such geese migrate northwards to nest and breed in Greenland or northern Scandinavia.
[
5
]
[
6
]
Early references
[
edit
]
An early, but not the first reference to the myth of the barnacle goose, is in the eleventh century
Exeter Book
of Riddles.
[
7
]
The riddle NUMBER 10, is asked as follows:
Neb wæs min on nearwe,         ond ic neoþan wætre,
flode underflowen,         firgenstreamum
swiþe besuncen,         ond on sunde awox
ufan yþum þeaht,         anum getenge
liþendum wuda         lice mine.
Hæfde feorh cwico,         þa ic of fæðmum cwom
brimes ond beames         on blacum hrægle;
sume wæron hwite         hyrste mine,
þa mec lifgende         lyft upp ahof,
wind of wæge,         siþþan wide bær
ofer seolhbaþo.         Saga hwæt ic hatte.
My nose was in a tight spot, and I beneath the water,
underflowed by the flood, sunk deep
into the ocean-waves, and in the sea grew
covered with waves from above, my body
touching a floating piece of wood.
I had living spirit, when I came out of the embrace
of water and wood in a black garment,
some of my trappings were white,
then the air lifted me, living, up,
wind from the water, then carried me far
over the seal's bath. Say what I am called.
To which the anticipated answer was "The Barnacle Goose".
[
8
]
In Ray Lankester's
Diversions of a Naturalist
(1917)
[
9
]
there is evidence of a serious literature debate arising from the work of
Max Muller
(1868),
[
10
]
together with a French Zoologist, Frederic Houssay,
[
11
]
George Perrot and
Charles Chipiez
.
[
12
]
The debate centered on the possibility that the barnacle goose myth could have been known to early Mycenaean settlers
c.
1600
–1100 BCE.
Lankester Fig 17 Diversions of a Naturalist  – Image from  " Ossuaire de Crète , Perrot "
Lankester claimed that drawings, often seen on Mycenaean pottery, were an
interpretation
by contemporary artists of the features of
typical geese
.  Lankester pointing out the way the Barnacle Geese were represented, wrote that the solution was:
The Mykenæan population of the islands of Cyprus and Crete, in the period 800 to 1000 years before Christ, were great makers of pottery, and painted large earthenware basins and vases with a variety of decorative representations of marine life, of fishes, butterflies, birds, and trees. … Others have been figured by the well-known archaeologists, … M. Perrot consulted M. Houssay, in his capacity of zoologist, in regard to these Mykenæan drawings, which bear … the evidence of having been designed after nature by one who knew the things in life, although they are not slavishly "copied" from nature…
He goes on to suggest that "it is fairly evident that the intention has been to manipulate the drawing of the leaf or fruit so as to make it resemble the drawing of the goose, whilst that in its turn is modified so as to emphasise or idealise its points of resemblance to a barnacle".
He summarises the possibility that Mycenaean drawings of birds – especially the goose – seen on pottery shows that the barnacle goose myth was known to settlers on the Greek islands, a thousand years BCE. He concludes his observations as follows:
… artists loved to exercise a little fancy and ingenuity. By gradual reduction in the number and size of outstanding parts—a common rule in the artistic "schematising" or "conventional simplification" of natural form—they converted the octopus and the argonaut, with their eight arms, into a bull's head with a pair of spiral horns … In the same spirit it seems that they observed and drew the barnacle floating on timber or thrown up after a storm on their shores. They detected a resemblance in the marking of its shells to the plumage of a goose, whilst in the curvature of its stalk they saw a resemblance to the long neck of the bird. … They brought the barnacle and the goose together

data.author: StemCells
data.article_summary: 科学家通过CRISPR技术编程干细胞，成功模拟了胚胎发育的最初几天。这项由加州大学圣克鲁兹分校团队开展的研究，利用胚胎样结构（胚胎模型，embryoids）来研究早期胚胎发育过程，而无需实际使用胚胎。他们使用小鼠干细胞，通过修改基因组的表达，控制特定基因的激活，引导形成胚胎发育所需的主要细胞类型。结果显示，80%的干细胞在几天内自组织成类似胚胎的基本结构，并表现出与活体胚胎相似的基因激活模式和细胞集体行为。该模型为研究胚胎发育及相关病理问题提供了新工具。研究发表于《Cell Stem Cell》期刊。

/ Scientists program stem cells to mimic first days of embryonic development
Scientists program stem cells to mimic first days of embryonic development
March 20, 2025
By
Emily Cerf
Share this story:
Twitter
Facebook
LinkedIn
Reddit
Programmable cellular models of embryos, known as embryoids, allow scientists to mimic the first few day of embryonic development.
The project team, left to right: Ali Shariati,
Sayaka Kozuki, and
Gerrald Lodewijk.
The earliest days after fertilization, once a sperm cell meets an egg, are shrouded in scientific mystery.
The process of how a humble single cell becomes an organism fascinates scientists across disciplines. For some animals, the entire process of cellular multiplication, generation of specialized cells, and their organization into an ordered multicellular embryo takes place in the protective environment of the uterus, making direct observation and studies challenging. This makes it difficult for scientists to understand what can go wrong during that process, and how specific risk factors and the surrounding environment may prevent embryo formation.
Scientists at UC Santa Cruz were able to engineer cellular models of embryos without ever experimenting with any actual embryos, allowing them to mimic the first few days after two sexually reproductive cells meet. They use CRISPR-based engineering methods to prompt stem cells to organize into “programmable” embryo-like structures, also known as embryoids, which can be used to study the role of certain genes in early development. These structures are not actual embryos but assemblies of lab-grown cells that self-organize in ways that mimic some aspects of early developmental stages.
Their results
are published in the leading stem cell journal
Cell Stem Cell
.
“We as scientists are interested in recreating and repurposing natural phenomena, such as formation of an embryo, in the dish to enable studies that are otherwise challenging to do with natural systems,” said Ali Shariati, assistant professor of biomolecular engineering and the study’s senior author. “We want to know how cells organize themselves into an embryo-like model, and what could go wrong when there are pathological conditions that prevent an embryo from successfully developing.”
Cell co-development
Shariati is an expert in stem cell engineering, a field that uses stem cells — unspecialized cells that can form any type of cell such as gut or brain cells — to study and solve biological and health problems.
This project, led by UCSC postdoctoral scholar Gerrald Lodewijk and biomolecular engineering alumna and current Caltech graduate student Sayaka Kozuki, used mouse stem cells that are commonly grown in the lab to guide them to form basic building blocks of the embryo.
The team used a version of CRISPR technology known as an epigenome editor, which does not cut DNA but instead modifies how it is expressed. They targeted regions of the genome known to be involved in the development of an early embryo. This allowed them to control which genes were activated, and induce the creation of main types of cells needed for early development.
“We use the stem cells, which are like a blank canvas, and use them to induce different cell types using our CRISPR tools,” Lodewijik said.
This method had the advantage of allowing different cell types to “co-develop,” which more closely resembles the natural embryo formation than the chemical approaches other scientists have used to develop different cell types.
“These cells co-develop together, just like they would in an actual embryo, and establish that history of being neighbors,” Shariati said. “We do not change their genome or expose them to specific signaling molecules, but rather activate the existing genes.”
The team found that 80% of the stem cells organize themselves into a structure that mimics the most basic form of an embryo after a few days, and most undergo gene activation that reflects the development process that occurs in living organisms.
“The similarity is remarkable in the way the cells organize themselves, as well as the molecular composition,” Shariati said. “[The cells require] very little input from us — it’s as if the cells already know what to do, and we just give them a little bit of guidance.”
The researchers observed that the cells showed a collective behavior in moving and organizing together.
“Some of them start doing this rotational migration, almost like the collective behavior of birds or other species,” Shariati said. “Through this collective behavior and migration they can form these fascinating embryonic patterns.”

data.title: The Race to Decipher Cuneiform in the 19th Century
data.author: Petiver
data.article_summary: 1850年代，楔形文字仍是未解之谜。四位学者展开竞争，试图破译这一古代书写系统，以揭示美索不达米亚文明的秘密。一块拥有3000年历史的 clay relic（泥板）成为焦点，它记录了亚述国王提格拉特·帕拉沙尔一世的军事胜利。最终，在大英博物馆的主持下，学者们取得了进展，逐渐解开了这一世界上最古老文字的奥秘。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：楔形文字破译历史及其学术研究过程的趣味性

不同观点：
• [正面评价] irchans认为文章非常 enjoyable（令人愉悦），强调了文章对楔形文字破译历史的精彩描述，特别是对一群学者竞争合作的刻画。这表明作者对文章内容的欣赏，尤其是其叙述风格和历史细节。

补充讨论：
• 文章重点描述了学者之间的竞争与合作，这可能是文章引人入胜的原因之一。
• 没有明显的对立观点或争议，评论整体呈现积极反馈，主要关注文章的叙述方式和历史内容。

data.title: CSS Form Control Styling Level 1 – W3C First Public Working Draft
data.author: tambourine_man
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了一种新的CSS属性`appearance: base`，旨在统一不同用户代理（浏览器）对表单控件的样式处理，解决以往样式不一致的问题。该属性使表单控件可以通过标准CSS和伪元素进行一致的样式定制，同时确保控件的可访问性和平台惯例。基本外观设计原则包括跨浏览器一致性、易于自定义、符合WCAG 2.2 AA标准、以及对不同模式和色彩方案的支持。文章还介绍了如何使用`appearance: base`来定制表单控件的外观，并讨论了`::picker()`伪元素，用于样式化表单控件的弹出部分，如选择框。总体目标是简化开发者对表单控件的自定义过程，同时保持其功能性和可访问性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[关于::picker()和popover/:popover-open在表单元素中使用的可行性和必要性]

不同观点：
• **反对强制使用popovers**：graypegg认为::picker()使用popover/:popover-open的方式感觉很奇怪，并质疑是否必须要求基础实现使用这种方法。他觉得这可能不是最佳选择，尤其在表单元素中。

• **支持标准化设计**：一些开发者可能认为使用popover/:popover-open可以为表单元素提供一致性和标准化设计，简化开发者的工作，并确保跨浏览器的一致体验。

• **对灵活性的需求**：另一部分开发者可能认为应该允许不同的实现方式，而不是强制使用某一种方式。他们主张在设计规范中保留一定的灵活性，以适应不同场景和需求。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：核心争议在于是否应该在表单元素中强制使用popover/:popover-open，或者允许其他实现方式。这涉及到设计的标准化与灵活性之间的平衡问题。

• **技术实现的复杂性**：一些开发者可能提到，强制使用某种技术可能会增加实现的复杂性，特别是如果现有的系统已经采用了其他方法。

• **用户体验的考虑**：还有讨论提到用户体验，认为不同的使用场景可能需要不同的实现方式，以提供最佳的用户体验。
